seo.title: About Us
seo.description: Learn about our history, our team, and our commitment to keeping your fleet on the road.

sections.title: Keeping fleets on the road since 1985
sections.subheadline: A family-owned dealership built on straight answers, fair deals, and service that lasts.

sections.body:
We started as a single-bay shop with a simple idea: treat every customer's truck like it's our own. Four decades later, we're still owned and operated by the same family, now serving customers across multiple locations.

Whether you're an owner-operator buying your first truck or a fleet manager coordinating dozens of vehicles, our team is here to help you buy smart, stay running, and get back to work fast.

sections.title: Come see the difference
sections.body: Visit any of our locations or reach out to our team.
